findings.title: isAccessTokenId never enforces the grant shortcut (wrong index and inverted condition)
findings.body: The grant-shortcut check in isAccessTokenId is broken in two ways. First, `substring(3, 5)` reads characters 4-5 of the token id, which is the token-type shortcut (e.g. 'rt'), not the grant shortcut. The grant shortcut is at indexes 4-5 (0-based), i.e. `substring(4, 6)`. The comment even says 'starts at character 4th char' but the code uses index 3. Second, the condition is inverted: `if (... .equals(expectedGrantShortcut)) return false;` rejects exactly the correct grant. Because the substring is the token type, the comparison is effectively always false, so the matcher never checks the grant at all. Expectations like expectCodeToToken/expectDeviceCodeToToken/expectRefresh/expectAuthReqIdToToken therefore pass for any grant shortcut, and the new assertions add no coverage. It should compare `substring(4, 6)` with `!equals`.

findings.title: rawTokenId null check duplicates grantType check and the message is wrong
findings.body: The constructor calls `Objects.requireNonNull(grantType, "Null rawTokenId not allowed")` instead of checking `rawTokenId`. As a result a null rawTokenId is never rejected, and a null grantType gets the wrong message on the second check path. Should be `Objects.requireNonNull(rawTokenId, ...)`. Note that getTokenContextFromTokenId can legitimately pass a raw id, so the intended contract should be decided explicitly, but the current code does not enforce what it claims.

findings.title: Public copy constructor Context(Context) removed from SPI class
findings.body: The diff deletes the public `Context(Context context)` copy constructor of `OAuth2GrantType.Context`. This class is part of the server-spi-private API that custom grant type providers extend and use. Any external provider or extension that calls the copy constructor will no longer compile or link. The removal is not mentioned in the PR description and is not needed for the feature (the added grantType field could be copied in the old constructor). This should be kept or removed deliberately with a note in the upgrade documentation.

findings.title: New abstract getShortcut() breaks all existing OAuth2GrantTypeFactory implementations
findings.body: `getShortcut()` is added as an abstract method on the public SPI interface `OAuth2GrantTypeFactory` with no default. Every third-party or downstream grant type factory now fails to compile and, at runtime, the implementation is missing an interface method. Since the encoder now calls getShortcut() during token creation (postInit, getShortcutByGrantType), a deployed custom grant without it would fail at startup or during token issuance. A default implementation or a fallback should be considered, or this should be documented as a breaking SPI change.

findings.title: Access token ID (jti / TOKEN_ID event detail) format changes for every access token
findings.body: initToken now sets the access token id to `<6-char-context>:<uuid>` for all access tokens. Everything that consumes the token id (the JWT `jti` claim, the `Details.TOKEN_ID` event detail, revocation or any client logic keyed on jti) now sees a different format. Clients or external systems that assume jti is a plain UUID, or that parse event token ids as UUIDs, will break. The change is only described as an internal optimisation in the PR text, and the public-facing impact on the `jti` claim and events is not called out or covered by a compatibility note.
